title: Multi-agent state primitives in lib/
objective: Promote the multi-agent state patterns proven in today's messenger/agents hardening into shared library code and adopt them across extensions. Deliverables: (1) lib/session-identity.ts — persisted per-session identity via custom entries (env override, generate-once-and-persist semantics), adopted by messenger; (2) lib/presence-shards.ts — sharded presence registry with dead-pid pruning and legacy migration, adopted by messenger; (3) generalized orphan-TTL lock semantics, adopted by the agents worker registry to fix its crash gap (stuck-running records, lost reports); (4) tests + README updates for each adoption. Done means: all three primitives exist in lib/ with tests, messenger and agents use them instead of hand-rolled equivalents, npm run check green, no behavior change for existing users beyond the documented crash-gap fix.

decisions.text: Original mission-mtulbjdz-d294 was destroyed mid-campaign by an autoresearch discard: discardAll staged everything (git add -A) and hard-reset, deleting all untracked non-ignored files including .pi/missions/. Root cause fixed in 7ead990 (init-time untracked snapshot; discards remove only experiment-created files). Mission recreated verbatim as mission-mtumm844-f327. Lesson recorded: untracked non-ignored state is unsafe during autoresearch campaigns on versions before 7ead990.
